folder_purpose: OKF Model Reference & 66degrees Email Content Writing Guidelines

brand_identity.core_value_proposition: Google Cloud Partner driving digital transformation, cloud modernization, data & AI innovation.
brand_identity.tone_of_voice: Professional, authoritative, client-centric, concise, and action-oriented.

best_practices: Include clear value proposition or relevant pain point.
Avoid spam triggers (e.g., ALL CAPS, FREE, Buy Now, excessive exclamation marks).
Personalize with company name or prospect role when applicable.
examples: How [Company] scaled AI initiatives on Google Cloud

best_practices: Complement the subject line without repeating it.
Provide a compelling hook or summary of the email's key benefit.
Immediate relevance/hook connecting 66degrees solutions to prospect context.
State the purpose within the first 2 sentences.

body_content.formatting: Short paragraphs (2-3 sentences), bullet points for readability, bold key takeaways.
content_rules: Focus on customer outcomes, not just technical features.
Highlight relevant Google Cloud competencies and real-world results.
Keep word count between 75 and 200 words for primary cold/promotional emails.

rules: Action-oriented wording (e.g., 'Schedule a 15-min strategy session', 'Read the case study').

sign_off_and_signature.format: Professional sign-off, full name, role, 66degrees contact details, and link to relevant resources/website.

dos: A/B test subject lines and CTAs.
Segment audience based on industry, role, and cloud maturity.
Reference real metrics and success stories from 66degrees case studies.
Ensure mobile-responsive layout and plain-text fallbacks.
donts: Don't overwhelm the reader with multiple conflicting calls to action.
Don't use heavy jargon without clear context.
